gp180.choicePolicy: Punk/Pop Crunch: Focus on mid-gain, bright British tones (Plexi style) with minimal effects to maintain dryness and punch.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A tight signal chain using a Boost for initial punch, followed by the UK 45 amp model paired with the UK Vintage 4x12 cabinet. Chorus is avoided, and only subtle reverb/delay are used to keep the sound dry and focused on aggressive mids.

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm playing.

blocks.gap: Using Boost instead of OD to keep the tone raw and focused on mid-range aggression, matching the 'punk' feel.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative for grit, but Boost is less colored and keeps the sound drier.

blocks.purpose: Add slight grit and mid-range punch without heavy fuzz or high gain.
blocks.gap: The RAT is chosen for its aggressive, focused midrange bite, perfect for punk crunch. Settings are dialed back to avoid excessive distortion.

alternatives.reason: More general purpose; RAT-style offers more character in the desired mid-range.
